# The group of each file of server/entity, by base name, for TestEntityLayers (entity_layers_test.go).
#
# Each line is "<file> <group>". core is what every entity builds on: Ent, living, damage, effects, physics,
# prefetch, line of sight and NBT. ai is the AI engine of mobs: brain, memories, goals, behaviours, navigation
# and pathfinding. registry is the registration of every entity type (DefaultRegistry, its config and the spawn
# table): it names every family, sits above them, and becomes server/entity/vanilla with spawn. Every other group
# is a family of entities.
#
# A new file of server/entity needs a line here. The groups are the cut of the monster split design; a family is
# a candidate subpackage.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Entries are sorted.
